question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He bought some fresh vegetables. || B. Ravi decided to go to the market. || C. He returned home and cooked dinner. || D. There, he met an old friend.

trick: Identify the independent sentence first. Nouns usually precede pronouns. 'Ravi' (B) comes before 'He' (A, C, D).
tip: Locate the noun to find your starting sentence.
